depends_on.notes: Portal is identity/entitlements authority and hosts /taskwise marketing + reverse-proxy path. Taskwise must not invent parallel identity. See portal GROUPS_AND_IDENTITY_CONTRACT.md, docs/pickiti/auth-sso.md, docs/pickiti/entitlements-api.md.

interfaces.name: pickiti-launcher-protocol
interfaces.notes: REAL current coupling: source + launcher_origin return-nav. Portal producers: lib/pickiti/launcher.ts, AppsContent TaskWise launchPath. Preferred M2 shared interface.

interfaces.name: entitlements_taskwise_pro
interfaces.notes: Portal PAID_APPS=('taskwise',); product taskwise_pro. Taskwise company feature flags are separate (local admin/features) — do not confuse with Pickiti entitlements.

interfaces.name: cors_and_origins
interfaces.notes: Taskwise CORS allows localhost:3500, localhost:3100, https://syswise.lk. Portal CORS includes TaskWise :3500. Env key names only: JWT_SECRET, DATABASE_URL, PORT (Taskwise); SYSWISE_SERVICE_KEYS etc. on portal.

interfaces.name: sso_handoff
interfaces.notes: NO app/sso/taskwise on portal; NO Taskwise /api/auth/sso-login found. TASKWISE_DOCUMENTATION.md §SSO (/sso?token=) is STALE. launch_views.LAUNCHABLE_APPS includes taskwise for future launch-code exchange — not adopted. Treat as future coordinated work, not current code path.

interfaces.name: local_syswise_admin_role
interfaces.notes: Director.isSyswiseAdmin + company onboarding approval live inside Taskwise DB — not portal User.is_superuser. Operational coupling to 'Syswise' brand/process, not portal JWT.

shared_services.name: postgres
shared_services.notes: Shared Postgres host typically :5432; Taskwise DB separate (taskwise_db / taskwise_local; .env.example uses taskwise_db). Keep taskwise_test for tests.

provides.name: notifications
provides.notes: In-app Notification model + /api/notifications (not a separate app).

provides.name: task_api
provides.notes: /api/tasks REST (CRUD + assign/accept/start/submit/return/approve/reject/reopen/cancel; block/unblock controllers exist, routes/FE incomplete).
